sanskrit: pañcasthāvāyava pañca manobindustathaiva cajālaṃdharaṃ kāmarūpaṃ pūrṇagiri śrīhastakaḥnadānadyaḥ samudrāśca bhuvanāni caturdaśaḥteṣāṃ saṃkṣepataḥ sādhyaṃ pravadanti śuvismṛteaharniśaṃ tuṣārābhaṃ śudhāṃ varṣatyadho mukhaṃtaralastu śudhājñeyā ghanobiṃdurudāhṛtaḥbiṃduvargasya sādhyena dehasiddhiḥ prajāyatemadhyamāmūlasaṃvyāpya sūryan tiṣṭhati dehināṃsarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tiṣthet annādiḥ pāvakaḥ sadātatsaṃyoge sthitaḥ prāṇaḥ viyogātmaraṇaṃ bhavetabhyāsāt kāmarūpena yogaṃ yoga vidoviduḥarogī ca bhave devī prāṇāpānaika yogataḥanayoḥ saṃgamaṃ sadhyaṃ rajobījasya sādhanaṃsamānāpānayoryogaḥ prāṇāpānekayogataḥnābhiśaktiḥ dvayormadhye oḍḍiyānaṃ taducyatepūrṇagiriḥ hṛdirmadhye śrīhadvaṃ tālukoparinavadvārāṇi saṃyamya kukṣimāpūrya vāyunāvaṃhneḥ pradīpanātnityaṃ annādeḥ pācanaṃ bhavetsvabhāvādbīja evāsau biṃduvibhartinānyadhāvāyureva paro dehe mūlasāraḥ prakīrtitaḥhṛdiḥ prāṇo guḍa'pānaḥ samāno nābhisaṃsthitaḥsthānavāyuñca saṃkṣipya vasthideśe punaḥ punaḥbrahmagranthiṃ tatotitvā vāyurviśati madhyamāṃmaṇipūraṃ nābhideśe tato vidhyātsadā gatiḥtālumūlaṃ sudhācakre bhitvārudrālayaṃ vrajet

sanskrit: vāyunā sahayogeṇa bindu tatraiva gacchatiśaṃkhinī nālasaṃprāpya cāsthi śūnyaṃ vibhartisaḥevaṃ mabhyāsayogeṇa naro brahmani yaḥ sthitaḥmāse māse'śvamedhaśca yajñasya ca phalaṃ bhavetdahyate sarvapāpāni koṭijanmārjitāni catapāṃsi yoni kathyaṃte yajñadānavratāni canandanti pitaraḥ sarve putro yogānusāriṇīyallabdhvā yoginaḥ sarve mucyate janma baṃdhanātśirasi śaṅkaro jñeyā tristhānaṃ muktidaṃ smṛtaṃjyotipuñja ca cakravat hṛdimadhye ca tiṣṭhatidhyāyet mūddhni śivajyoti ghṛtapiṇḍasivoddhṛtaṃmelakaṃ vāyubiṃdūbhyāṃ kartavyaṃ manasā budhaiḥtathācakreṣu sarveṣu pratyaṃ jyotiḥ pradṛśyatejyotiṣi trīṇi tatraiva teṣu cātmā pratiṣṭhatitatraiva cāsthi śūnye tu kālacāraḥ palāyatejyoṭiṣāṃ vāyu biṃdurnāmelakaṃ muktidāyakaṃvāyurbindu manaścātmā tasya sarvasthiraṃ bhavetcalate calamānosau mṛtyumabhyeti śāśvatadhyānātītaṃ paraṃ brahma sarvaśāstreṣu gopitaṃādhāro bhuvanānāñca dehasthā dehavarjitāḥjanma vṛddhyādi rahita ātmāsarvagatānyayaḥanitya khaṇḍayet sarvaṃ yatkiñcit manasārjitaṃkaraṇāni manaścaiva yadā brahmaṇi nīyateanimādi guṇāstasya * * * * * * * *?tadūrddhañca paraṃ viṣṇoḥ hṛdaye ca guṇānvitaṃ

sanskrit: tadūrddhañca mahāśūnyaṃ yatra brahma yathāśramaṃkālasya rakṣayaṃ jñātvā svayaṃ brahma samo bhavetpratyadde jñānacintāyāṃ na kiñcidanyathā bhavetsiddhāḥ siddhaṃ prakurvanti te yānti paramā gatiḥevaṃ yogasamāsādhya gacchantiṃ paramāṃ gatiasatyarnocatā krūrāḥ dvijavedaviniṃdakāḥālasau pīḍitā ye ca kāmakrodhaprapīḍitātena mukti padaṃ yāti dharme nānena pārvataikecit dhyānaṃ yugaṃsaṃti vijñānañca paraḥ paraṃsādhyaḥ cānu kramaṃ kṛtvā te yānti paramāṃ gatiṃsarvapāpakṣayaṃ tasya brahmaṇasadanaṃ bhajetdinekanāśvamedhānāṃ yajñānāñca phalaṃ labhetataḥ puṇyataraṃ śāstraṃ nocātra vidyate kvacit
